description: Ministry of Agriculture and Plantation - Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980 Order under Section 04
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of members to the Pesticide Technical and Advisory Committee under the authority of the Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980. The notification is a statutory instrument/order issued by the Minister exercising powers vested by existing legislation. While it does name individuals being appointed, this is done in the context of implementing a regulatory framework rather than describing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about establishing a regulatory committee under specific legal authority, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
